topic: Duties and responsibilities of Air Technical Officers.
syllabus_extract: Duties and responsibilities of Air Technical Officers.
specific_objectives: 1.1.1.2 Trainee will be able to understand the qualification of responsibilities and promotion regulations.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of promotion regulations and qualification requirements for Air Technical Officers; Instructor supervision of trainee queries regarding career progression.
intro_questions: What is the primary role of an Air Technical Officer?
List three key responsibilities of an Air Technical Officer.
How does an Air Technical Officer differ from a regular Airman?

development.content:
Qualification requirements for ATO
Promotion regulations for ATO
Key duties of ATO
Responsibilities in maintenance
Reporting and documentation

Maintenance oversight duties
Safety compliance roles
Resource management tasks
Personnel supervision duties
Record keeping obligations

Career progression paths
Training and certification needs
Leadership development goals
Performance evaluation criteria
Future role expectations

summary_questions: Explain the difference between qualification requirements and promotion regulations for Air Technical Officers.
Describe how an Air Technical Officer ensures safety compliance in maintenance operations.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the duties and responsibilities of Air Technical Officers as discussed in this lesson, focusing on their role in unscheduled maintenance and security of detachable panels, to be used in the next lesson plan.

pft_rows.syllabus: Demarcation of responsibilities between trades in area of unscheduled maintenance, security of detachable panels and access doors, secure and stowage of loose articles, system equipment’s viz oxygen, air conditioning, auto pilots, auto stabilization and flight control system, micro switches, electrical components in engine and fuel system and static lines cameras, air radio installations, survival equipment, assisted escape system, and weapon system.
